name: Guest_friendship
definition: Two individuals (or their houses) belonging to different communities, the Guest_friends (or Guest_friend_1 and Guest_friend_2), are bound by a lasting, reciprocal and often hereditary relationship of hospitality. The bond is typically initiated when one party is received in the other's house and is sealed by an exchange of Tokens (guest-gifts); it obliges each party, and often their descendants, to receive, protect and give gifts to the other whenever he comes, and it may be sanctioned by a divine Guarantor. Unlike Guest_and_host, the relationship outlasts any single visit and is symmetrical: each party is potentially both host and guest.

core_FEs.name: Guest_friend_1
core_FEs.definition: One party to the bond, typically the one in focus (e.g. the referent of ξένος).

core_FEs.name: Guest_friend_2
core_FEs.definition: The other party to the bond, to whom Guest_friend_1 is a guest-friend.

core_FEs.name: Guest_friends
core_FEs.definition: Both parties expressed together (e.g. as a plural subject or with a reciprocal).

noncore_FEs.name: Token
noncore_FEs.definition: The gift(s) exchanged that establish or attest the bond (ξεινήια, δῶρα).

noncore_FEs.name: Origin_event
noncore_FEs.definition: The reception or meeting at which the bond began.

noncore_FEs.name: Guarantor
noncore_FEs.definition: The deity who sanctions the bond and punishes its violation (Ζεὺς ξείνιος).

noncore_FEs.name: Duration
noncore_FEs.definition: How long the bond has lasted, including its hereditary standing (παλαιός).

noncore_FEs.name: Descriptor
noncore_FEs.definition: A characterization of the bond or of a party as a guest-friend (πατρώϊος 'ancestral', προσκηδής 'caring').

lexical_units.gloss: guest-friendship, friendly relation between persons or states
guest-friend, a party to the bond
gift exchanged as Token of the bond

examples.text: [τῷ|Guest_friend_2] δ' [Ὀδυσεὺς|Guest_friend_1] [ξίφος ὀξὺ καὶ ἄλκιμον ἔγχος|Token] ἔδωκεν, ἀρχὴν ξεινοσύνης [προσκηδέος|Descriptor]

name: Honorific_prerogative
definition: A Grantor (a community, an army in assembly, a leader or a host) allots to a Recipient a Prerogative: a material share set apart from what is common (a prize from the spoils, a choice portion of meat, a funeral mound) or a standing privilege, as public acknowledgment of the Recipient's status, age or merit (the Basis). Holding the Prerogative constitutes honour; being without it is public dishonour. Unlike Rewards_and_punishments, no judgment of a specific action is presupposed, and unlike plain Giving the transfer is evaluative and status-marking.

core_FEs.name: Recipient
core_FEs.definition: The person honoured with (or lacking) the Prerogative.

core_FEs.name: Prerogative
core_FEs.definition: The honorific share, prize or privilege.

core_FEs.name: Grantor
core_FEs.definition: The person or group that allots the Prerogative.

noncore_FEs.name: Basis
noncore_FEs.definition: The status, age, rank or merit for which the Prerogative is due.

noncore_FEs.name: Occasion
noncore_FEs.definition: The event at which it is allotted (division of spoils, sacrifice, funeral).

lexical_units.gloss: gift of honour, prize, prerogative; last honours
gift of honour; (later) privilege of age
without a gift of honour (Recipient lacking the Prerogative)
to honour someone by allotting a portion of honour

name: Plaything
definition: An object, the Plaything, is made, kept or given for the amusement of a User (prototypically a child) rather than for practical use. It is valued for the Delight it affords and is often a small, attractive object (a trinket) that may be given as a present or traded.

core_FEs.name: Plaything
core_FEs.definition: The object used for play or amusement.

core_FEs.name: User
core_FEs.definition: The one who plays with or enjoys the Plaything.

noncore_FEs.name: Material
noncore_FEs.definition: What the Plaything is made of.

noncore_FEs.name: Delight
noncore_FEs.definition: The pleasure or amusement the Plaything affords.

noncore_FEs.name: Manner
noncore_FEs.definition: The manner of making or of playing.
